Al-Mansour Medical / Almansour Pharmaceutical Industries (MPI) is a Baghdad-based manufacturer of therapeutic drugs and medical supplies founded in 1989. It produces solid and liquid dosage forms, focusing on antibiotics, pain relievers, vitamins, and treatments for chronic and common ailments. [](https://www.linkedin.com/company/almansour-pharmaceuticals)

- **PectoLin** (Oral Syrup - Antihistamine & Expectorant)

- **BronqyWay** (Oral Syrup - Bronchodilator & Expectorant)

- **FoliAid** (Tablets - Vitamin supplement)

- Generic and branded solid lines (pain relief, antibiotics, chronic disease therapies) [](https://mpi-iq.com/index.php/solid-products/)
